title: The Hacktivist Heist
story: In the bustling city of Silicon Valley, our tale unfolds at 'ByteTech', a renowned tech startup. Late one night, the company's secure database was breached, resulting in a massive leak of sensitive client information. The CEO, Jameson Oakley, woke to find himself under siege by a mysterious hacker named 'ByteButcher'. 'ByteButcher' left a cryptic message: 'Your greed knows no bounds. Prepare to face the consequences!'
forensicClue: The encrypted message 'Your greed knows no bounds. Prepare to face the consequences!' seems to be a reference to a popular online gaming scenario.
question: Who is the culprit and how did they break into the database?
options: Option A: Marlon Blackwood (head of HR and ByteTech fanatic), reason: Focused on a password guessing attack.
Option B: Olivia Nexus (Cybersecurity expert and former ByteTech employee), reason: Access to sensitive information and a personal grudge.
Option C: Alexander Rise (CEO's right-hand man, secret gamer), reason: The encrypted message ties him to a gaming community.
Option D: Dr. Harper Griffin (head of R&D and knowledge of the company's network), reason: Access to the network and an unknown third-party program used in the attack
